bundle.shortDescription: Run a model on your own machine and lend it to the network.
bundle.longDescription: Common is a client for a decentralised network of models running on the machines people already own. It reads this machine, downloads the one model the network is short of, and serves it. Questions you ask go to the network, which routes each one to the machine best suited to it.
